crossRefs.note: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.
But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the…
We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we…
Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice, and rejoice with you all.
because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service…
By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

translations.web: So then death works in us, but life in you.
translations.bsb: So then, death is at work in us, but life is at work in you.
translations.kjv: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
translations.asv: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
